name: Separator
description: Draws one hairline between sections of related content.

length.description: How far a vertical rule runs: full stretches across the parent, control stops at the compact control height with a small margin either side (the toolbar divider). Ignored on horizontal rules.

label.description: Words between two horizontal rules; a sibling of the rule, never inside its separator role

when: Dividing sections that spacing alone cannot separate
Labelled breaks such as an Or divider
Splitting groups of controls inside a toolbar (length="control")
whenNot: Whenever spacing already reads as a break
guidelines: Use sparingly — stacked rules read as noise
The parent owns the space around the rule: put it in a Stack and set gap
One weight only: the rule is always a hairline in the line colour
orientation="vertical" stretches across the parent; use length="control" between toolbar controls
Add aria-hidden when the rule is purely decorative
accessibility: The rule carries role="separator" and aria-orientation
A label is readable text beside the rule, not its accessible name

examples.name: Default
examples.description: One hairline; the Stack gap sets the space around it.

examples.name: With Label
examples.description: Words sit between two rules for a major break.

examples.name: Vertical
examples.description: Divides items sitting in a row.

examples.name: Toolbar
examples.description: length="control" stops the rule at the control height between toolbar groups.
